rationale: tools/scripts/fetch_skia_for_release.py keeps the Windows ARM64 Skia slice under build/win-gpu/lib/Release/arm64/, the directory FindSkia.cmake already selects for an arm64-win target, instead of flattening it. windows-x64 and every other platform layout is unchanged. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves; the fetch now produces the layout the build already requires.
